decks.name: Letters 1: friends and false friends
decks.desc: One key word per letter for А К М О Т (look and sound as in English) and В Е Н Р С У Х (look English, sound different), plus first words made only from them

decks.name: Letters 2: new shapes
decks.desc: One key word per letter for Б Г Д З И Й Л П Ф Э Ы, plus words that use them

decks.name: Letters 3: soft vowels and hushing sounds
decks.desc: Я Ё Ю, Ж Ш Щ Ч Ц, the soft sign ь and the hard sign ъ, each in a key word, plus hard and soft pairs

decks.name: Greetings and politeness
decks.desc: Hello, goodbye, please, thank you, sorry, and the phrases that keep a conversation polite

decks.name: Formal and informal
decks.desc: The same idea said to a stranger (вы) and to a friend (ты): greetings, questions, requests

decks.name: People and family
decks.desc: Family members, friends, and the words for introducing them

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Numbers to a thousand, rubles, prices and paying

decks.name: Time and days
decks.desc: Days of the week, today and tomorrow, clock times and months

decks.name: Food and drink
decks.desc: Ordering, Russian dishes, drinks, and what to say at the table

decks.name: Shopping and things
decks.desc: Things you buy and carry, shops, and asking for them

decks.name: Home and city
decks.desc: Rooms, buildings and places in town, with where things are

decks.name: Daily routine
decks.desc: Everyday verbs in the present and past: get up, work, eat, read, sleep

decks.name: Describing people and things
decks.desc: Adjectives for size, age, colour and quality, in all three genders

decks.name: Work and study
decks.desc: Jobs, studying, and saying what you do and where

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: Directions, transport, and asking the way

decks.name: Health and help
decks.desc: Asking for help, at the pharmacy and the doctor, and polite commands

decks.name: Likes and feelings
decks.desc: Likes, wants, feelings and reasons: мне нравится, мне холодно, потому что

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: False friends, calques of English, and replies that sound wrong in Russian

decks.name: Top nouns
decks.desc: The most-used nouns in the nominative, each with its gender: person, year, time, hand.

decks.name: Top verbs
decks.desc: The most-used verbs, as aspect pairs where you need both (imperfective first), with the я-form.

decks.name: Top adjectives
decks.desc: The most-used adjectives in the masculine, with the forms that change: new, last, main, real.

decks.name: Top adverbs
decks.desc: Time, place, manner and degree: already, here, often, very, together.

decks.name: Top pronouns
decks.desc: They, this, which, oneself, nobody, someone, and the forms меня, мне, его: the whole useful set.

decks.name: Top prepositions
decks.desc: In, on, with, from, without, after and the rest, each with the case it takes. Short ones are said with the next word.

decks.name: Top conjunctions
decks.desc: Joining words: and, but, when, if, so that, than, although.

decks.name: Top interjections
decks.desc: What Russians really exclaim: ой, ого, ух ты, блин, ну.

decks.name: Top words
decks.desc: Question words, particles (не, же, бы), it's-necessary words (надо, нельзя), numbers to twenty and the days of the week.

decks.name: Compliments
decks.desc: Kind things to say about food, work, skills, homes and people, and how Russians answer a compliment.

decks.name: Flirting
decks.desc: Words people flirt with, phrases built from them, asking someone out, and kind ways to say no.
